title: Reassignment lock (Turkish request)
prompt: Atama için yeni bir kural ekleyelim: teslim tarihine (`dueAt`) 48 saatten az kalmış bir görevin atanan kişisini sadece proje sahibi (owner) değiştirebilsin. Editörler için `TaskAssigneeField` salt okunur olsun ve neden değiştiremediklerini görsünler; owner'lar eskisi gibi değiştirebilsin. Sebep: teslimden 48 saat önce atanan kişiye SMS ile hatırlatma gidiyor ve son dakika değişiklikleri müşterilere çelişkili mesajlar gitmesine yol açıyordu. Kuralı kodda belgele ki ileride kimse kaldırmasın.

criteria.text: The rule is documented by exactly one `Business Logic:` / `Why:` / `Rule:` block written in English (no Turkish in the comment) even though the request was in Turkish, with each labelled line a single sentence and no extra prose.

The block sits immediately above the feature-level declaration that owns the lock (e.g. `canReassignTask` in features/tasks/policy.ts, or an equivalent named function/hook/const under src/features/tasks), not inline inside a function body or JSX, and not in src/components/ui or a generic component.

`Why` states the supplied reason (assignees get an SMS reminder 48 hours before the due date, and last-minute changes sent customers conflicting messages); `Rule` states that within 48 hours of dueAt only owners may change the assignee. No invented reason (e.g. accountability, workload balancing, audit).

Derived pieces carry no comments of their own: the 48-hour constant, the date arithmetic, `isLocked`/`canReassign` booleans, the null-dueAt case, and the read-only branch in TaskAssigneeField have no inline narration and no second business block. The existing `// TODO: replace with the assignee picker` placeholder may stay or go, but no new narration is added.
The 48-hour window is a named constant defined once in the tasks feature and reused; the rule check is one function/const used by the field, not duplicated logic or a repeated magic number.

TaskAssigneeField uses the rule with the viewer (useViewer): editors inside the 48-hour window cannot change or clear the assignee and see an explanation; owners still can; tasks with null dueAt are not locked; the existing props contract is unchanged; the project typechecks.
